research_question: Does a sparse two-step BBO quote-propagation event—an outward one-sided price revision followed by same-direction opposite-side catch-up with full spread restoration—leave enough residual directional asymmetry to survive frozen Coinexx-like P75 execution for 30 seconds?

source_basis.source: Quote revision and information flow among foreign exchange dealers
source_basis.reconstructible_claim: FX quote revisions carry information and revisions on one side can influence subsequent pricing decisions.

source_basis.source: An Empirical Analysis of Exchange Rates using High Frequency Data
source_basis.reconstructible_claim: Observed FX quote-side asymmetry includes periods in which ask revisions lead and bid revisions subsequently respond; quote revisions on opposite sides can be positively related.

source_basis.source: A Structural Error-Correction Model of Best Prices and Depths in the Foreign Exchange Limit Order Market
source_basis.reconstructible_claim: Best bid/ask prices are dynamically linked; spread deviations induce quote adjustment toward equilibrium.

hypothesis: A completed ask-up-only -> bid-up-only sequence with restored-or-tighter spread is bullish; a completed bid-down-only -> ask-down-only sequence with restored-or-tighter spread is bearish. Entry on the first strictly subsequent executable P75 quote captures residual information propagation after both sides have repriced.
falsification_condition: The single preregistered event definition fails the Stage-A supply/day gate or direct-net gate under frozen execution. No rescue with thresholds, sessions, sides, volume imbalance, timing windows, or exit retuning.

event_definition.event_stream: consecutive native Dukascopy BBO price-changing events; volume-only revisions are ignored for event adjacency
event_definition.bullish_leader: ask increases while bid is unchanged
event_definition.bullish_follower: the next BBO price-changing event is bid increase while ask is unchanged
event_definition.bearish_leader: bid decreases while ask is unchanged
event_definition.bearish_follower: the next BBO price-changing event is ask decrease while bid is unchanged
event_definition.spread_restoration: follower spread must be <= spread immediately before leader event
event_definition.entry: first strictly subsequent raw tick after follower event
event_definition.overlap: each completed follower closes its event; the same follower row cannot simultaneously seed another event
